description: This file contains utility functions for constructing a tree of filter scope nodes within a dashboard, including traversal logic and exporting the main function getFilterScopeNodesTree.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses dashboard components to build a tree of scope nodes based on component types and filter fields.

methods.name: getFilterScopeNodesTree
methods.description: Main exported function that initiates traversal from the dashboard root component to generate the scope nodes tree.
